metadata.title: Multivariable Alexander polynomials of twisted torus links via Dehn surgery
metadata.abstract: Let $T(p,q;r,s)$ be the twisted torus link obtained from the torus link $T(p,q)$ by adding $s$ full twists to $r$ adjacent strands, and let $C$ be an unknotted circle encircling those strands. For all $p$, $q$, and $r$ we compute the multivariable Alexander polynomial of $T(p,q)\cup C$ in closed form. A relation of Silver and Williams between the Alexander polynomials of a link and of its $1/n$ Dehn fillings then gives a closed formula for the multivariable Alexander polynomial of every twisted torus link $T(p,q;r,s)$, answering a question of Adnan and Park. When $\gcd(p,q)=1$, so that $T(p,q;r,s)$ is a knot, the formula is a sum of $pr$ monomials with coefficient $+1$, divided by cyclotomic factors, and its exponents are governed by an elementary counting function on the orbit of $q$ modulo $p$. Because the numerator has no cancellation, we are able to give the degree for all $s$ and a simple non-fiberedness criterion.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 扭torus link的多变量Alexander闭式公式
analysis.workSummary: 对T(p,q;r,s)由r股加入s全扭得到的twisted torus link，先计算与包围这些股的无结圆C的并链Alexander多项式，再经Silver–Williams的1/n Dehn filling关系得到全部该类链环闭式公式。gcd(p,q)=1时结情形分子为pr项正系数单项式之和，因无消去而求得所有s的次数及简单非纤维化准则。
analysis.breakthrough: 回答Adnan–Park公式问题，并让次数和部分非纤维性可直接读取。
analysis.limitations: 闭式计算限给定twisted torus族；非纤维化准则不等于纤维结的完整充要分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 可计算结不变量成果明确，但曲率几何关联间接。
